card.text: Explore Alkmene in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Published convex shape with a shape-aware thermophysical size calibration. The grid marks unavailable imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT shape model
shape.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
shape.summary: Convex light-curve shape with thermophysical volume-equivalent diameter 58.6 ± 1.2 km. The published fit uses the same pole family; an alternative pole remains possible. The grid marks unavailable imagery and rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 29.3 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
